# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Trust in God in Time of Distress

---

**6:1** Blessed is the man whose heart is ready [to call upon] the name of the LORD;
when he remembers the name of the LORD, he will be saved.

**6:2** His ways are ordered by the LORD,
and the works of his hands are overseen by God.

**6:3** His soul will not be terrified by an evil dream;
when he passes through rivers and storms of waters, he will not be troubled.

**6:4** He rises from his sleep, blesses the name of the LORD;
when his heart is at peace, he sings to the name of his God.

**6:5** He asks mercy from the LORD for all his household;
and the LORD hears the prayer of everyone who fears God.

**6:6** May the LORD make good all the petitions of those who fear him;
the LORD blessed the devout ones with his salvation.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
